description: This file defines the LinkItem class for Drupal, implementing a custom field type 'link' with properties, schema, and methods for handling link data, including URL, title, options, and sample data generation.

classes.name: LinkItem
classes.description: Defines a custom 'link' field type for Drupal, with properties for URI, title, and options, including schema, default settings, sample data generation, and utility methods.

methods.name: defaultFieldSettings
methods.description: Returns default settings for the link field, including title visibility and link type.

methods.name: propertyDefinitions
methods.description: Defines the data properties (uri, title, options) for the link field.

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Provides the database schema for storing link data, including columns for uri, title, and options.

methods.name: fieldSettingsForm
methods.description: Builds the form for configuring field settings such as link type and link text allowance.

methods.name: generateSampleValue
methods.description: Generates a sample link value, either external URL with random domain or internal base URL.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the link field is empty.

methods.name: isExternal
methods.description: Determines if the link is external.

methods.name: getUrl
methods.description: Constructs a Url object from the stored URI and options.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value of the link field, handling array or scalar input.
